findings.detail: Column count and gap are emitted directly on style:section-properties, contrary to ODF1.3 sections17.11 and17.12: these attributes belong to a child style:columns element. Existing upstream test checks substrings only.
Multi-column text:section is closed before fallback anchor for empty sections. Keep the empty-section anchor inside its wrapper.
Gap uses toStringAsFixed without finite/plain-decimal validation. Reuse normalized length validation and omit invalid or negative gaps.
Different tests added at same odt_table_tab_fidelity_test.dart path. Preserve both variants or combine coverage; 60a has a unique invalid column-width check.
odt_tab_stop_fidelity_test.dart expects rounded hyphen/underscore tabs to share style. Newer exports distinguish leader-text, so use same-leader rounded controls and retain distinct-leader checks.

Keep min-row-height semantics, finite/nonnegative row dimensions, valid color normalization, independent border flags.
Normalize border flags to booleans for cache identity if combining implementations.
